title: Miaomiao + Libre Checksum Failed, sensor works with LibreLink
symptom: After replacing a Libre sensor, the user gets 'Error: Checksum Failed' in xDrip when using a MiaoMiao transmitter, while LibreLink scans normally and shows normal readings. The issue persists across multiple devices and firmware versions, with occasional correct readings.
cause: The maintainer (tzachi-dar) suggests the problem is likely with the MiaoMiao transmitter, not a software issue, as the Libre reading changes every minute and comparing readings from MiaoMiao and xDrip would likely show differences.
fix: The maintainer suggests resetting the MiaoMiao and trying again, and advises against running without checksum as it is dangerous. No definitive fix is provided; the issue is closed without a confirmed resolution.
evidence_quote: It seems to me that your problem is in the miaomiao and not a software issue. The libre reading changes every minute. So, this should give you enough time to do the following: Have the miaomiao read something and in the same time have xDrip read the same data and compare if you are getting the same data.
